description: Medidas de los Planes de Gestión de Riesgos de Inundación is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Table indicating the measures of the Flood Risk Management Plans within the scope of inter-community river basin districts. For each measure, its ARPSI code, progress status, prioritization, and responsible authorities are specified. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Measures of Flood Risk Management Plans" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
